hold_text: Tier 2: adds a route that backs up then GROWS the live VM's boot volume 47 -> 53 GB and grows its partition/filesystem. Operator decision (popup, 2026-11-02 ~14:00Z, verbatim): "Free +6 GB only". Never past 53 GB (billed). The manager merges.
why: Tenancy block+boot storage measured 194/200 GB (oci-capacity-report, issue #22387, PR #22378); +6 GB stays inside Always Free. Live disk is at 100%; the VM-SPARSE-SYNC lane (PR #22386) frees ~16 GB of caches, so this is headroom, not the incident fix.
